text:
DeployBot: starting rollout v4.0.0 -> prod. Canary slice: 7% across runtime pool. Observability: embeddings-vec service p99 latency jumped ~2.3x on canary nodes. Autorevert: enabled but suppressed for now (human review). Pls ack and recommend rollback scope.
Noor: ack. I see the spike too. Appears isolated to embeddings-vec ingress.
Ethan: logs show increased long-tail GC + cache thrash on canary hosts. Not seeing errors in text-gen route.
DevOpsSam: could do a full release revert or isolate the route back to stable pool. Prefer route isolation to reduce blast radius.
SRE_Maya: agree with isolation. If we can cut embeddings traffic back to runtime v3.15 (stable) while leaving other routes on v4.0.0, that minimizes customer impact.
ProductZ: need to coordinate customer comms if dedicated customers are affected. Who owns the high-QPS embeddings accounts?
Rachel: tagged sales for the list. I'll assemble high-QPS seats and share to #customer-success.
Noor: suggested command to isolate route (ops):
```
# route isolation (traffic override)
redwoodctl traffic override --scope route --route embeddings-vec --target-version v3.15 --duration 60m --reason "canary p99 regression"
```
Ethan: also open revert PR for the runtime change (repo@commit def4567) so we have a tracked rollback if we need code revert.
DeployBot: NOTE: traffic overrides during the change window require 2FA confirmation from an Ops+SRE. Cutoff for automated revert: 3472157920.
DevOpsSam: executing override now, will provide confirmation.
DevOpsSam: /run redwoodctl traffic override --scope route --route embeddings-vec --target-version v3.15 --duration 60m --reason "manual-isolate-canary-regression"
DeployBot: action acknowledged: embeddings-vec routed to v3.15 by DevOpsSam at 3472157933. Canary traffic for v4.0.0 reduced to 0% for embeddings-vec.
SRE_Maya: watching metrics — p99 dropped to baseline within 90s. error rate 502s went from 0.5% -> 0.03%. good sign. :tada:
Noor: filing PR #789 to revert kernel flags. linking to incident.
ProductZ: hold on release notes: add line "embeddings-vec routed to stable runtime v3.15 due to canary latency regression; investigating" and freeze other release notes until we validate.
Rachel: customer advisory draft: "We temporarily routed embeddings traffic to a stable runtime after a performance regression was detected in our canary. No customer data lost; minimal disruption expected. Engineering investigating root cause." Who to send?
ProductZ: send to enterprise list + customers with dedicated pools. Rachel, ping me for approval, I'll join comm.
Ethan: runbook items: 1) reproduce in staging, 2) perf test with GC knobs, 3) land revert or optimized patch, 4) redeploy canary.
DevOpsSam: set monitoring alert window to 45m; if p99 creeps above 1.5x baseline we either extend isolation or escalate to full rollback.
SRE_Maya: added temporary dashboard and slack alert.
DeployBot: archived action and events under incident/INC-2026-046.
Noor: creating postmortem starter doc and assigning owners.
ProductZ: once we confirm fix in staging and canary, we'll schedule a small phased cutover and update release notes.
Rachel: customer advisory approved, sending now.
DevOpsSam: override expires at 3472158293 unless extended. Will update if we extend.
Ethan: thanks all. Good containment.
SRE_Maya: moving to monitoring watch channel for the next 45m.
Noor: closing thread here; will open postmortem when root cause known.
DeployBot: thread closed by DevOpsSam at 3472157960.
